description: Trial results the VASI-shaped extraction does not reach, each with the reference group its figure must be read against. Two kinds: a published primary outcome whose full text is not fetchable (HI-Light, Vitiligo Noticeability Scale), and a posted secondary outcome on an instrument the arm table does not parse (NCT03099304, patient global impression of change). reference_basis says what the reference is, because it is not always the day-1 randomisation: NCT03099304 re-randomised at week 24, so a week-52 figure must be read against who was on that regimen afterwards, which the record states and which is 11 rather than 31 for the 0.15% arm. Counts are stored, not derived, because a rate kept to one decimal does not always recover its numerator. These rows are kept out of curation/topline-results.json, which is frozen by hash because v0.4, v0.5 and the evidence ranking are defined by it. No row is a VASI threshold, so none can reach a model.
